names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 24 октября ст. ст., «Петр (Богородский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The line itself declines the name and gives it without the surname, as «Сщмч. Петра пресвитера».

feast.note: His name page heads «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 24 октября», the January day being the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Петра пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: His line is his own and not part of the two priests above it: a year later, 1938, and a singular rank word. The line calls him пресвитера and the link behind it иерей, the same grade, so the office and the types agree. **The surname is the fold to watch on this day and it does not arise**: the corpus holds eleven folders whose whole stored form is a bare «Петр», and this one stores the fuller «Петр (Богородский)» the link gives, which none of them shares. The calendar carries no life for him.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints after his name on 24 октября ст. ст., «Сщмч. Петра пресвитера (1938).» The calendar carries no life page for him and gives no day.
